meta.title: Ask-every clarification protocol
meta.description: Adds a standing system-prompt protocol with a three-stage gate: (1) restating and clarifying the need through an ask_user_question popup, (2) presenting a numbered plan-direction checklist selected via popup, and (3) a fixed final question — does this satisfy your need, may I execute — before any work starts. Prompt-layer enforcement; tunable via the ask-every row config.
